title: Checks bind only what their example fixes
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0043 no longer matches the current design.
decision: For each assertion of a check, the words of the example it binds are named, and a failing case exists only where the example's words call for one. A check reads nothing from the operator's host that the example does not name.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
